description: Sends ticket confirmation and escalation emails via Office 365 Outlook

operations.description: Sends a confirmation email to the user when their ticket is created

emailMessage.Subject: Help Desk Ticket Created: {ticketNumber} - {title}
emailMessage.Body:
Dear {userName},

Your help desk request has been received and a ticket has been created.

Ticket Number{ticketNumber}
Title{title}
Category{category}
Priority{priority}
StatusNew
Assigned Team{assignedTeam}
SLA Deadline{slaDeadline}

Our team will contact you within the SLA window. You can check the status of your ticket at any time by chatting with the Help Desk agent and providing your ticket number.

If your situation becomes more urgent, please reply to this email or contact us directly.


Best regards,
IT Help Desk Team

operations.displayName: Send escalation email to IT management
operations.description: Notifies IT management of a critical or high-priority ticket requiring immediate attention

emailMessage.Subject: 🚨 ESCALATION - {priority} Priority Ticket: {ticketNumber} - {title}
emailMessage.Body:
⚠️ This ticket requires immediate attention.

Ticket Number{ticketNumber}
Title{title}
Priority{priority}
Category{category}
Submitted By{userName} ({userEmail})
Affected Users{affectedUsers}
SLA Deadline{slaDeadline}
Description{description}

Please assign a technician and acknowledge this ticket as soon as possible.


IT Help Desk Triage Agent

operations.description: Notifies the user when their ticket has been resolved

emailMessage.Subject: Help Desk Ticket Resolved: {ticketNumber} - {title}
emailMessage.Body:
Dear {userName},

Your help desk ticket has been resolved.

Ticket Number{ticketNumber}
Title{title}
Resolution{resolution}
Resolved Date{resolvedDate}

If you are not satisfied with the resolution or the issue persists, please reply to this email or open a new ticket.


Best regards,
IT Help Desk Team

setupInstructions.step1: In Copilot Studio, go to Settings > Connections
setupInstructions.step2: Add a new Office 365 Outlook connection
setupInstructions.step3: Sign in with the help desk service account (e.g., helpdesk@yourdomain.com)
setupInstructions.step4: Update emailSettings in settings.json with the correct email addresses
setupInstructions.step5: Ensure the service account has Send As permissions if sending on behalf of a shared mailbox
